comment: Generated by scripts/emc.py from mods/<port>/emc/policy.json. Explicit values for uncraftable mekanismgenerators items and conversions for machine steps ProjectE cannot see; the FAKE|no_emc conversion never resolves, so excluded items get no EMC. Everything else is derived from recipes by ProjectE.

mekanismgenerators_generators_wind_gener.comment: Mekanism stores this crafting recipe as mek_data because the result keeps energy data; the cost is the crafting ingredients, and transmutation does not copy that data.

mekanismgenerators_generators_hohlraum.comment: Mekanism machine recipe ProjectE does not map, priced at its item ingredients. Infusion is priced at the enriched material, which yields eight times the raw chemical: one enriched carbon is 80 mB, and each hohlraum takes 10 mB plus four gold dust.

mekanismgenerators_fill_bioethanol_bucke.comment: The bio generator turns one bio fuel into 200 mB of bioethanol, so five bio fuel and a bucket fill one bucket. Bio fuel is a fifth of an EMC, and five fifths plus the bucket are the bucket plus one EMC.

mekanismgenerators_fill_deuterium_bucket.comment: An electrolytic separator splits heavy water, which a filtered pump makes from water, into deuterium. Water has no EMC, so a deuterium bucket costs the empty bucket.

mekanismgenerators_fill_tritium_bucket.comment: A solar neutron activator turns lithium into tritium. Lithium is evaporated from brine, which is water, so a tritium bucket costs the empty bucket.

mekanismgenerators_fill_fusion_fuel_buck.comment: A chemical infuser combines one deuterium and one tritium into two fusion fuel. Both inputs cost an empty bucket, so each fusion-fuel bucket costs one empty bucket.
